Part A (AB or BC): Graphing Calculator Required
Question 1 9 points
General Scoring Notes
• The model solution is presented using standard mathematical notation.
• Answers (numeric or algebraic) need not be simplified. Answers given as a decimal approximation should
be accurate to three places after the decimal point. Within each individual free-response question, at most
one point is not earned for inappropriate rounding.
Male birds of a certain species arrive at a nesting area over a thirty-day period. The rate at which the male birds
arrive at the nesting area at time t days is modeled by a differentiable function M, where M t ( ) is measured in
number of birds per day. Selected values of M t ( ) are shown in the table.
t (days) 0 5 10 15 20 25 30
M t ( ) (birds per day) 2 7 16 6 5 2 0
(Note: Your calculator should be in radian mode.)
